title: PV Buck with Perturb-and-Observe MPPT (C++ C-block)
description: Photovoltaic buck stage with a Perturb-and-Observe maximum-power-point tracker implemented as a QSpice C++ C-block (Controller20), driving a behavioral PV-module source model. Demonstrates MPPT convergence over a long (120 ms) transient.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: pv_mppt_po.qsch is Alonso's schematic and controller20.cpp his C-block MPPT source. pv_mppt_po.cir is the self-contained QUX netlist (behavioral PV-module and current-sense models inlined) referencing the Controller20 device; build controller20.cpp into controller20.dll before simulating. The transient runs 120 ms, so simulation and the resulting .qraw are large.

workflows.title: PV Buck with Perturb-and-Observe MPPT -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files, build the C-block DLL, then simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).
